item.title: Lilly/Engage Bio Acquisition
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly has acquired Engage Bio in a deal valued at approximately $202 million, as reported by BioSpace and Fierce Biotech. The acquisition gives Lilly a preclinical DNA delivery platform, bolstering its capabilities in gene therapy and nucleic acid therapeutics. The transaction underscores Lilly's aggressive deal-making strategy to expand its pipeline.
  • MoAs: N/A (acquisition focused on platform technology)
  • Sources: BioSpace, Fierce Biotech

item.title: Parabilis IPO
item.description:
• Summary: Parabilis Biotech, a biotech company focused on peptide therapeutics and desmoid tumors, has filed for an IPO shortly after inking a deal with Regeneron. The IPO plans were revealed by BioPharma Dive, Endpoints News, and Fierce Biotech. Parabilis aims to raise funds to advance its pipeline into Phase 3 trials, capitalizing on a hot IPO market.
  • MoAs: Peptide therapeutics (MoA varies by candidate; includes potential inhibition of signaling pathways in desmoid tumors)
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech

item.title: Bristol-Myers Squibb AI Deal with Anthropic
item.description:
• Summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb has partnered with Anthropic to deploy the Claude AI platform across its enterprise for widespread AI adoption to accelerate drug R&D globally. The deal was reported by Fierce Pharma and BioPharma Dive. BMS aims to leverage AI to streamline drug discovery and development processes, potentially reducing timelines and costs.
  • MoAs: N/A (AI platform)
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, BioPharma Dive

item.title: Incyte/Genesis AI Drug Discovery Pact
item.description:
• Summary: Incyte has paid Genesis $80 million to expand an existing AI-fueled drug discovery collaboration, as reported by Fierce Biotech. The expanded pact will leverage generative AI to identify novel drug candidates across multiple therapeutic areas, reinforcing Incyte's commitment to AI-driven discovery.
  • MoAs: N/A (AI drug discovery collaboration)
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Takeda Pay-for-Delay Lawsuit
item.description:
• Summary: Takeda faces an $885 million hit following a landmark pay-for-delay lawsuit verdict, as reported by Pharmaceutical Technology. The lawsuit alleged that Takeda engaged in anti-competitive practices by paying generic manufacturers to delay market entry of cheaper versions of its drug. The verdict could have significant financial and reputational implications for Takeda.
  • MoAs: N/A (legal matter)
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Gilead/Yuhan API Deal
item.description:
• Summary: Gilead Sciences has signed a $140 million supply agreement with South Korean contract manufacturer Yuhan Corporation to secure active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for its antiviral portfolio. The Fierce Pharma article explains that the deal strengthens Gilead’s supply chain resilience and expands Yuhan’s role as a key API producer. The partnership highlights the growing trend of pharmaceutical companies diversifying manufacturing sources, particularly for critical HIV and hepatitis drugs.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Qiagen/Nvidia AI Drug Discovery
item.description:
• Summary: Qiagen and Nvidia have announced a partnership to leverage AI for drug discovery, combining Qiagen's bioinformatics expertise with Nvidia's computing power to accelerate target identification and development.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Serb Idefirix Rights
item.description:
• Summary: Serb has secured the rights to Idefirix (imlifidase), an IgG-cleaving enzyme for desensitization in kidney transplantation. This acquisition strengthens Serb's specialty pharmaceutical portfolio in transplant medicine.
  • MoAs: Imlifidase: IgG-cleaving endopeptidase (reduces donor-specific antibodies).
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: GHO Capital/CBC Merger
item.description:
